subject: RECORD clause
notes: Landed by kb/Work PB1277 (w61f). cite.py --check 13.18.43.4 'regardless of the types of characters used' -> OK §13.18.43.4 3). Record sizes are DataItem.ByteWidth (a national position = 2 bytes, D-N1), never the carrier's ImageWidth: RECORD CONTAINS 10 over PIC N(10) is refused COBOL2010 (20 bytes), FROM 16 TO 40 over X(10)+N(5) compiles (20 bytes), a DEPENDING 12 WRITE of a PIC N(10) record answers 44 (min 20). The sibling FileModel.AreaRecord (the largest record, whose view a READ splices through) now also chooses by bytes: X(15) vs N(10) picks the 20-byte N(10) record (was X(15): a READ delivered 7.5 national characters).
